name: Mochi
bio: Calm and permanently sleepy. Believes every problem can be solved by a nap, and is right about 40% of the time.
taps: Zzz... mrrp.
I was not asleep. I was resting my eyes, professionally.
Is it nap o'clock yet?

name: Kaya
bio: Greedy, round and named after toast. Will happily sit on your quiz if it is shaped like a snack.
taps: Is that toast? Please say toast.
I am not round, I am aerodynamic.
One more snack. For science.

name: Byte
bio: Takes everything very literally, including naps. Likes the exact middle of the rug.
taps: I have 9 lives and 0 backups.
Mrrp. Have you tried turning me off and on again? Do not.

name: Muah Chee
bio: Chewy, patient and slightly sticky. Lives inside the yarn basket, tangled on purpose.
taps: Mrrrp. (Sticky paws, happy heart.)
Peanuts and sesame: the cat way.
I am not stuck. I am committed.

name: Satay
bio: Smells faintly of charcoal and ambition. Will do anything for a skewer, and has never been offered one.
taps: Is that peanut sauce? Is it? I can wait.
Stripes are just seasoning.
Mew. Skewers are my love language.

name: Ondeh
bio: Soft on the outside, a surprise burst in the middle. Hides behind big leaves, strictly for ambush purposes.
taps: Pop! That was me. Pop.
Pandan is a personality.
Mrrp. (I contain coconut. I will not elaborate.)

name: Pixel
bio: Mischievous. Knocks things off shelves, then looks at you like you did it.
taps: That shelf looked lonely. Now it is a floor thing.
Mew. (Translation: I did nothing.)
Psst. I know the next answer. I am not telling.

name: Bit
bio: The smallest cat in the house and the quickest to forgive. Quietly impressed by anything that twinkles.
taps: Mew! (That was a small one. We are fine.)
I am a very tiny cat. I am also a very big deal.
Boop. Everything is fine.

name: Pisang
bio: Spends the whole day at the top of things and has an opinion about every level.
taps: Mew from the top! The view is excellent.
Careful, I am a little bit ripe.
Mrrow. I meant to fall. Obviously.

name: Kopi
coat: dark brown with a milky chest
bio: Warm, strong and a little bit sweet. Wakes up slowly and then absolutely refuses to stop.
taps: Kopi-O, no sugar. For the cat, I mean. Not for the cat. Wait.
I run on coffee. Mostly other people's.
Mrrrow. (Extra shot of cuddles, please.)

name: Tau Huay
bio: Wobbly, gentle and sweet. Only visits after a perfect round, then falls asleep mid-sentence.
taps: Mrrp... wobble wobble.
Is it dessert time? It is always dessert time.
Zzz... soft soft soft.

unlock.label: Get every answer right in a round

name: Milo
bio: Arrives like a surprise iced drink: cool, a bit dusty on top. Loyal to players who come back three days in a row.
taps: Mew. (Iced, please. With extra powder.)
I am here for the counter and nothing else.
Mrrow. Milo dinosaur approved.
